rationale: Totals published to 4 decimals; some regional fuel aggregates to 2 decimals. Regional rounding tolerance is 0.05 GWh. Cross-table differences over 0.001 GWh are disclosed; up to 0.01 GWh (10 MWh, 1/1000 of displayed 0.01 TWh) is accepted for this descriptive report only, without claiming the source difference is resolved.
growth: (current / previous - 1) * 100, both from same release; undefined at zero baseline
residual: total - fossil - nuclear - renewables; keep visible, do not silently label as renewable
scope: Generation, fuel composition, regional differences, and cross-vintage revisions; excludes trade, consumption, emissions, causal drivers and forecasts.
